dct_description_sm: The OCO-2 Water Vapor (Total Column Average) layer displays the total gaseous water within a vertical column of the atmosphere over land and ocean and is measured in millimeters (mm). Water vapor (H₂O) is one of the retrieved variables in the OCO-2 retrieval algorithm.

The OCO-2 Total Column Water Vapor is an ancillary product of the retrieval algorithm used to measure the CO₂ concentrations derived from the OCO-2 Level 2 Lite product. OCO-2 makes eight simultaneous, adjacent measurements, each with a spatial resolution of 2.25 km x 1.29 km. These measurements are then mapped onto a 500 m² grid. The repeat cycle for OCO-2 is every 16 days.
Nelson, R. R., et al.: High accuracy measurements of total column water vapor from the Orbiting Carbon Observatory-2, Geophysical Research Letters, 43, doi:10.1002/2016GL071200,

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2014-09-06 to 2026-07-28.
